newsitem.title: FRANCE: Eurotunnel sees Eurostar next week.
newsitem.headline: Eurotunnel sees Eurostar next week.

text.p: Channel Tunnel operator Eurotunnel hopes the Eurostar high-speed train service between Britain and France can resume service at the start of next week, co-chairman Patrick Ponsolle said on Wednesday.
Full repairs in the fire-damaged tunnel could take three to five months to complete, he said on Europe 1 radio.
"Our target is to re-establish Eurostar traffic and our tourist shuttles at the beginning of next week," Ponsolle said.
But he said the resumption of passenger traffic through the tunnel depended on the approval from safety authorities which Eurotunnel hoped to receive by the end of this week.
Ponsolle said investigators did not know how the fire had started, but said he could exclude no cause, including sabotage.
"That is the part of the event that remains mysterious," he said.
